title: LucHost loading and invocation
summary: Validate canonical Resolver output against current Runtime, grants, API policy, capability fields and trusted adapter checks before registering the package. Discovery and invocation use the same capability registry and authority.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: register_adapter
operations.notes: Duplicate protocol_id refuses. Optional bind_host runs first. No deadline; retry after success is a duplicate.

operations.name: load
operations.notes: grants defaults empty, authorization hash None, check_only false. check_only validates without registering capabilities. Successful retry conflicts with registered capability ids. No deadline. Host API and concrete adapter errors additionally propagate; see their interfaces.

operations.name: discover

items.description: id, protocol, description, package, requested/effective APIs, permissions, editable scopes and capability_effect.

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced by this synchronous Python seam. Retrying a read observes the current state.

operations.name: describe

output.description: A detached JSON capability mapping with id, protocol, description and adapter-owned fields; compile supplies input_schema and output_schema.

operations.notes: Optional adapter describe hooks may propagate their own errors. Host json_value bounds output; no deadline.

operations.name: invoke

output.description: Original adapter result; .model is validated when present.

operations.notes: Reauthorizes every effective API then invokes and validates model output. Concrete API/adapter refusal codes also propagate; no closed generic error union or deadline. input_error_code can convert invalid input to ToolRefused.

invariants.text: The Host validates the whole package before capability registration; check_only returns before registration.
Loose manifests cannot bypass Resolver context, authority or reauthorization checks.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: LucHost itself checks no interface. A layered Luc is held to its module's interface before it loads, in the two places layers are applied (luc_local.lay_on and the bootstrap loop of official_luc, through luc_interface_gate). At run, invoke validates every input and output against the capability's schemas, which the load gate holds to the contract; an error code outside the contract or a missed deadline is not counted as a break. That matters once a layer can bring code (the code sandbox); today none can.
